book.name: MESAIR HRAHRA HA OK
book.title: OUON-AW-OK KE MA MESAIR HRAHRA HA OK Ouon-aw ok, Jon se ma mesair kow hrahra ha hok non

content: Israel uwrsa 144,000 hom God so meir se ma lonok hom non

Ha owhnan seme kiy-ira ha lowpway menkin, hakwe sawk ensel iha-iha-aw ki ohiy so por iha-iha-aw mon nakrok-kay me lira. Homkwe howniy iha-iha-aw me nekie sous huon, ki o, sour-yawp-ar o, now o, hme lway huwhuw ame.

Ha sehe kiy-ira ha lowpway menkin, sawk ensel prueyn, ey kaie ko se le se makiy-ira huon. Hiykwe lwayr peyow peyow God so kendol-lor non. Hiykwe sawk ensel iha-iha-aw, krai, ki o, sour-yawp-ar o, seme mon piapay e ma kow me wouk-ok aiopey hay non senkin me,
“Homkwe ki o, sour-yawp-ar o, now lowpwarowp o, peyr peie saw-mon piapay o. Peyr hromkwe God so mey-uwr lowpwarowp mo ine-maku mokwe kendol-lor non lokiamaun kreik kow ha pa.”
Hanekwe sawk senkin mekow, uwrsa mo meir kendol-lor non ma lokiamaun kreik mokwe sankaw, 144,000. Somokwe Israel mo uwrsa uwrku iha seys mu nareysyar non hom ma kekie nona nona ne hom non.

content.text: Uwrku kamon kamon-aw mo meir mokwe sankaw, Juda so uwr-ku ko mokwe, 12,000. Ruben so uwr-ku ko mokwe 12,000. Gat so uwr-ku ko mokwe 12,000.
Aser so uwr-ku ko mokwe, 12,000. Naptali so uwr-ku ko mokwe 12,000. Manase so uwr-ku mokwe 12,000.
Simeon so uwr-ku ko mokwe 12,000. Livai so uwr-ku ko mokwe 12,000. Isakar so uwr-ku ko mokwe 12,000.
Sebulun so uwr-ku ko mokwe 12,000. Josep so uwr-ku ko mokwe 12,000. Benjamin so uwr-ku ko mokwe 12,000.

content: Uwrsa popua hay hom God se ma swa-hokruw me-ihey hom non

Sohiy so meyki hokwe, ha sa uwrsa popua hay hok nuw-hokruw konpakon kawk ke lira. Hmo meir mokwe uwr posokwaw sor meir-yay ley. Uwrsa somokwe owh-ohi senkin senkin, uwr-kayn senkin senkin, kipay senkin senkin, wouk-ok senkin senkin non ko me le-nene. Homkwe sia-king o, sipsip-ney o, hoho inour mon nakrok-kay, seyr klos weyspey me-aw nak-ie liyay, seyr pokriy-ma me nak-nakruok, hmo iha mon kokwe.
Homkwe wouk-ok aiopey hay non senkin nuw-me,

content.text: “Huonok-prosue-yor kokwe hromo God, sia-king mon ma liwak o, seyr Sipsip-ney o, hoho mon le.”

content: Ensel lowpwarowp homkwe sia-king o, sios makwey-uwr o, ay ihaiha-aw su ma lwayr sohom o, hme nakrok awndiy kawk nok, ine ki mon sia-king ko inour mon kuayk won sowkway me-ihey, God se.

content.text: “Ok-ar! Me-ihey-ok o, panpaniowni o, mawkhow ihey-ar o, kar me ey ok o, uru ayaw-ar o, krai o, seyr hay ipey-ar o, God hiykwaw ka nak-wayr peyow peyow. Ok-ar!”

content: Sios mo makwey-uwr prueyn hiykwe sawk hane senkin mesopok, “Uwrsa klos weyspey meiamei me ma lie omokwe posokwaw mo, seyr perey suko me le mo?”

Ha kiy-onuayk me, “Ara, hakwe nonkway korey, hunkwe nonkway.” Hiy sa hane senkin me, “Uwrsa somokwe low piap-araw aiopey hay ko ouon ko me ma lousne-sa-ousne ha hom non. Homkwe hmo klos meipey mokwe Sipsip-ney so nioh non po peyryapeyr weyspey.

Homkwe God so sia-king ko inour mon seme nakrok-kay, seyr hye me-ihey mey me-aw meio kow, eypok arawh, eypok arawh, hyo a pekney-weys mon. Uwr, sia-king mon ma liwak hiykiaw kokwe ohriar non-wak sous-a-sous ey, hmekwe.
Uwrsa somokwe siowp ma-lokrue lopa, seyr hu krah-ma-krah lopa. Seyr ey-li o, ya-li senkin senkin o, hme ma-loum pouk-ma-pouk lopa.

Payhokuaw, Sipsip-ney, sia-king ompok mon ma lwak hiykwe hmo naykih-ar lwak ey. Hiykwe hmekwe ki-saw-hu, su ma lwayr peyow peyow ey mon hiy-anok anok nok ey. Seyr God hiykwe hmo eheyr-hu lowpwarowp nene ko me noh ahahay kow ey.”
